title: Midsummer Night's Dream Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Midsummer Night's Dream is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 123 GRAYTON STREETWelcome to Midsummer Night’s Dream | Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Midsummer Night’s Dream, a charming Seaside, Florida cottage that truly lives up to its name. With a dreamy location and thoughtful coastal design, this home is perfectly situated one block from the beach and directly across from Seaside’s West Side Pool, offering unmatched convenience for enjoying the best of life on Scenic Highway 30A.Prime West Side Seaside LocationLocated in one of the most desirable areas of Seaside Beach, Midsummer Night’s Dream places you just steps from the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf. Being directly across from the West Side Pool and within easy walking distance to Seaside’s town center, dining, shopping, and events, this home offers a true walkable Seaside experience.Inviting Screened Porch & Coastal Outdoor LivingA wide, screened-in front porch welcomes you with peaceful views of the pedestrian footpath and the nearby pool. This relaxing outdoor space is ideal for slow mornings with coffee, afternoon reading breaks, or quiet evenings enjoying the coastal breeze under the stars.Comfortable First-Floor Sleeping RetreatsThe first floor features three spacious bedrooms, thoughtfully designed for comfort and privacy. Two bedrooms offer king beds with private en-suite bathrooms featuring walk-in showers. The third bedroom serves as a king primary suite, complete with a full bath and direct access to the front porch—creating a serene retreat after a day at the beach.Light-Filled Second-Floor Living & EntertainingUpstairs, the open-concept living area is filled with natural light and designed for gathering. The well-equipped kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area and bar seating, making it easy to enjoy meals together. A convenient half bath is also located on this level.The living room features a 75-inch TV with streaming access, including Netflix, Apple TV, Disney+, Max, and BritBox—perfect for movie nights or relaxing evenings in. Step out onto the expansive second-floor porch, where outdoor dining and lounge seating offer treetop views and glimpses of the West Side Pool.Private Rooftop Deck with Gulf ViewsClimb the spiral staircase to discover one of the home’s most memorable features—a private rooftop deck with stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico. This breezy perch is ideal for sunset cocktails, sunbathing, or simply taking in the sights and sounds of Seaside, Florida.Thoughtful Amenities for a Seamless StayMidsummer Night’s Dream is equipped with everything you need for a comfortable coastal getaway, including a washer and dryer, outdoor shower, pole-mounted grill, and multiple gathering spaces both indoors and out. Every detail is designed to make your stay effortless and memorable.Need More Space? Add HonahleaTraveling with a larger group? You can also rent Honahlea, the guest cottage for Midsummer Night’s Dream. Honahlea adds a king bedroom, a living area, and a loft with two twin beds—perfect for kids. Renting both homes together creates an ideal Seaside family compound for extended families or groups.Architectural Legacy of SeasideBoth Midsummer Night’s Dream and Honahlea were designed by award-winning architect Scott Merrill, architect of the iconic Seaside Chapel and recipient of the Seaside Prize (2012). This architectural pedigree adds an extra layer of significance and authenticity to your Seaside stay.Whether you’re drawn by the location, the views, or the timeless Seaside design, Midsummer Night’s Dream offers a truly magical coastal retreat on 30A.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,848 square feet of thoughtfully designed coastal livingBeach access: One block away, approximately a 2-minute walk (176 yards)Private Seaside residential beach: Natchez Pavilion, featuring nearly one-half mile of private shoreline—the largest stretch of private beach on 30AAcross from the West Side Pool: Direct pool views and easy accessOutdoor living: Two large porches plus a private rooftop deck with Gulf viewsSleeping accommodations: Three king bedrooms, each with a private en-suite bathroomLaundry: Washer and dryer on-sitePeacock Alley Linens: Fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughout the homeSeaside amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote includes: Two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes (pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority)Guest services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Two parking passes issued; golf carts are considered a vehicle and count toward parking limits; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; exceptions for medical or special circumstances require an approved permitNo pets permittedSTR23-002400
